name: Contexa
heroTitle: Protect communities in real time with explainable moderation and policy-aware AI
heroLead: Detect abuse early, prioritize risk, and maintain a defensible audit trail for every moderation decision.
summary: Contexa helps organizations monitor harmful interactions across social, messaging, gaming, and community channels. It combines context-aware detection, human review workflows, and immutable decision logging so teams can act quickly without sacrificing transparency.

highlights.title: Real-Time Risk Scoring
highlights.copy: Identify cyberbullying, harassment, and harmful behavior as messages are created, enabling intervention before damage spreads.

highlights.title: Explainable Moderation
highlights.copy: Every decision is traceable, with context, policy rationale, and full audit records for compliance and operational review.

highlights.title: Modular Trust Controls
highlights.copy: Support community safety teams with escalation, triage, workflow automation, and policy tuning across diverse environments.
